title: Drop the SubagentDepthError and seedDescriptorTurn root exports from dsh-subagent
task:
Problem: packages/subagent/subagent/src/index.ts:116 re-exports `SubagentDepthError` (packages/subagent/subagent/src/child-agent.ts:31) and index.ts:100 re-exports `seedDescriptorTurn` (packages/subagent/subagent/src/descriptor-seed.ts:23). Neither has a consumer outside packages/subagent/subagent/src: the depth tests in packages/subagent/subagent-in-process-driver/tests/subagent-in-process-driver.spec.ts:270-291 match the error by `name` and fields without importing the class, `seedDescriptorTurn` is called only from continuation.ts:437, and the README documents the seam's depth vocabulary as `AgentOptions.subagentDepth`, `assertSubagentMaxDepth` and `delegationDepthOf(agent)` (packages/subagent/subagent/README.md:63), which stay exported. The proposed prune note lists `SubagentDepthError` in the row quoted in the source anchor; the other symbols in that row were already made private.

Required: remove the two root re-exports; keep the class and the function exported from their own modules for their same-package callers; keep messages, codes and behavior unchanged; run the driver spec to prove the depth assertions still hold. No behavior change.

Constraints: no README change (it does not name either symbol), no Agent Note; do not touch the exported depth vocabulary. The coverage check runs the subagent packages whose tests own this package's src; until T-0020 merges, packages/subagent/subagent/tests/out-of-process.spec.ts:77 fails under uid 0 for a reason unrelated to this ticket, so run acceptance as a non-root user or after T-0020.
